question: Describe a situation where you had to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
transcript: Um, yeah so basically I think I did this kind of thing at my last job. Like, there were some stakeholders that were maybe not totally on board with what we were doing. Um, I kind of like talked to them and I think, you know, I managed to sort of convince them eventually. It was sort of a difficult situation. I believe the outcome was OK in the end. Um, yeah, basically we got there.
